course_subtitle: Welcome, future coding hero! Embark on an exciting visual programming adventure with Tobi 🐻. Snap colorful blocks, build amazing games, and unlock cool medals! 🐻🎮🚀

stations.title: Station 1: Introduction to PicToBlox & Animal Racing
stations.desc: Learn how to navigate the PicToBlox workspace, drag color-coded puzzle blocks, and program your very first sprite race!
stations.story:
🐻 Hello, creative future coder!

I am your friend Tobi the Coding Bear 🐻, and today I will accompany you on a magical block coding adventure to build Station 1: Introduction to PicToBlox & Animal Racing! 🌟

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • 🐻 PicToBlox Workspace Layout: Exploring the Stage (preview), Blocks Palette (drawers), and Script Area (workspace).
  • 🐻 Dragging & Snapping Blocks: Combining blocks vertically like Lego blocks to build sequences.
  • 🐻 Stage Coordinate System: Moving sprites along horizontal X and vertical Y grid axes.
⛳ Session Objectives:
  • 🎯 Position the racing sprites on the left boundary using coordinate blocks.
  • 🎯 Make your favorite animal sprite glide smoothly to the finish line.
🏆 Session Project: Animal Racing Game: Program a rabbit and a turtle sprite to compete in a race to the finish line, playing cheering sounds when they cross!
🧱 New Puzzle Blocks Introduced:
go to x: 0 y: 0
glide 1 secs to x: 100 y: 50
say Let's race! for 2 seconds
start sound cheering ▾

Let's drag and snap these blocks in your playground! Once your game is running, click the big green medal button on the right to claim your rewards! You've got this! 🌟🚀
stations.simple: Imagine PicToBlox blocks are like Lego blocks! You snap one block on top of another to build a towering command that tells your sprite exactly where to go!
stations.hint: Click the big green button below: Done! Claim My Medal! once you build the race game in PicToBlox!
stations.challenge: Build your Animal Racing game in PicToBlox and click the green medal button below!
